summary.text: Shannon Welsh is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 70, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She defeated Jackson Howe in the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary, and she lost the 2024 general election for the same seat to incumbent Mickey Petitto.
